task: Search the web for small, local German radio stations. Specifically look for stations that currently have a poor, outdated website or lack a dedicated mobile app. Read the existing 'german_radio_stations.md' file in the Shared folder to see which stations are already listed. Find 3-5 new qualifying stations, and append their Name, Location, Website, and a brief note on why their digital presence needs improvement to the 'german_radio_stations.md' file. Ensure no duplicates are added.
context: The goal is to find leads for selling a custom radio streaming app. We only want stations with poor digital presence so we can pitch them our solution.
name: Find Local German Radio Stations
